Board of Trustees

The Town of Palisade is represented by a seven-member Board of Trustees who are elected for four-year terms, with a limit of two consecutive terms.  The trustees are responsible for setting town policy and creating and amending a balanced annual town budget.
To contact the Board of Trustees, please email: 
boardoftrustees@townofpalisade.org

 

Board of Trustee Meetings and Work Sessions may be live-streamed on Zoom at:
https://us06web.zoom.us/j/3320075780?omn=88612397465
(Zoom Meeting ID #: 332 007 5780)

Purpose, Powers, and Duties

Sec. 2-22. - Board of trustees; election, powers, qualifications.
(a) At the municipal election held in April of 1974, the Trustees to be elected shall be elected to a four-year term of office. Thereafter all Trustees shall be elected to hold office for four-year staggered terms.

(b) The Board of Trustees shall constitute the legislative body of the Town, shall have the power and authority, except as otherwise provided by statute, to exercise all power conferred upon or possessed by the Town, and shall have the power and authority to adopt such laws, ordinances and resolutions as it shall deem proper in the exercise thereof.

(c) The Mayor and each Trustee shall be a resident of the Town and a qualified elector therein. If the Mayor or any Trustee shall move from or become, during the term of his or her office, a nonresident of the Town, he or she shall be deemed thereby to have vacated his or her office. (Prior code 2.20.030; Ord. 685 §1, 1993)

(d) A member of the Board of Trustees may be removed from office pursuant to Section 31-4-307, C.R.S.

MAYOR Greg Mikolai

Elected in 2020, and re-elected in 2024, Mayor Mikolai is serving his second four-year term as Mayor of Palisade. **Mayor Mikolai represents the Town of Palisade on the Grand Valley Regional Transportation Committee (GVRTC)

MAYOR PRO-TEM Sarah Matchett

Elected in 2024, Mayor Pro-Tem Matchett is serving her first four-year term as a Trustee. Mayor Pro-Tem Matchett was appointed as Mayor Pro-Tem by the Board of Trustees in 2026.  **Mayor Pro-Tem Matchett represents the Town of Palisade on the Grand Junction Economic Partnership (GJEP)

TRUSTEE Jeff Snook

Elected in 2024, Trustee Snook is serving his first four-year term as a Trustee.  **Trustee Snook serves as ex officio for the Board of Trustees on the Palisade Tourism Advisory Commission

TRUSTEE Rick Fox

Elected in 2024, Trustee Fox is serving his first four-year term as a Trustee. **Trustee Fox serves as a representative of the Board of Trustees on Palisade Fire 

TRUSTEE Ed Seymour

Elected in 2026, Trustee Seymour is serving his first four-year term as a Trustee. **Trustee Seymour serves as a representative of the Board of Trustees on Palisade Fire 
 

TRUSTEE JoAnn Rasmussen

Elected in 2026, Trustee Rasmussen is serving her first four-year term as a Trustee.  **Trustee Rasmussen represents the Town of Palisade on Colorado West Land Trust and on the Colorado Municipal League (CML)
 

TRUSTEE Amy Gekas

Elected in 2026, Trustee Gekas is serving her first four-year term as a Trustee.
